scripts.setup:asr: cd python-asr && python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:asr:x64: cd python-asr && arch -x86_64 ${PYTHON_X64:-python3} -m venv venv-x64 && arch -x86_64 venv-x64/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && arch -x86_64 venv-x64/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:tts: cd python-tts && ${PYTHON:-python3} -m venv venv && venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:tts:x64: cd python-tts && arch -x86_64 ${PYTHON_X64:-python3} -m venv venv-x64 && arch -x86_64 venv-x64/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && arch -x86_64 venv-x64/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/fetch-yt-dlp.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.build:electron:arm64: node scripts/fetch-yt-dlp.mjs --arch=arm64 && tsc -b && vite build && BUILD_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.cjs && mkdir -p release && mv dist/*.dmg release/Vv-Transcribe-arm64.dmg && rm -rf dist/mac-arm64 dist/*.yml
scripts.build:electron:x64: node scripts/fetch-yt-dlp.mjs --arch=x64 && tsc -b && vite build && BUILD_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --mac --x64 --config electron-builder.cjs && mkdir -p release && mv dist/*.dmg release/Vv-Transcribe-x64.dmg && rm -rf dist/mac dist/*.yml
scripts.build:electron:win: node scripts/fetch-yt-dlp.mjs --arch=x64 && tsc -b && vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.cjs
